SELECT id, payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status, active_requested_payment_id, transaction_key, failure_code, requested_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ( SELECT cancellation.id, cancellation.payment_id, cancellation.idempotency_key, cancellation.cancel_amount, cancellation.cancel_reason, cancellation.request_type, cancellation.requested_by, cancellation.status, cancellation.active_requested_payment_id, cancellation.transaction_key, cancellation.failure_code, cancellation.requested_at, cancellation.canceled_at, cancellation.created_at, cancellation.updated_at, payment.provider, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY payment.provider ORDER BY cancellation.requested_at, cancellation.id ) AS provider_position FROM payment_cancellations AS cancellation INNER JOIN payments AS payment ON payment.id = cancellation.payment_id WHERE cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' AND cancellation.request_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'ADMIN', 'ADMIN_REJECTION') AND cancellation.requested_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) ) AS batch ORDER BY provider_position, CASE WHEN provider = #{priorityProvider} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, requested_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
